title: Mac Monitor
background: Closing the window keeps monitoring active. Quit (⌘Q) stops this session. The boot preference and current service are controlled independently.
deleteData: Delete saved account, history and TLS data when uninstalling
refreshHelp: Refresh the monitor address, network interfaces, and recording status. This does not restart the service.
lanHelp: LAN access is enabled automatically on en0. Sign in with the same account and password. Other devices must trust this Mac’s local CA certificate for HTTPS.
quitFailed: The service did not confirm shutdown ({code}). The control window will close; monitoring may still be running.
serviceUnavailable: The monitoring service is unavailable ({code}). Click Start service to resume.
browserFailed: The browser could not be opened. Copy the monitor address into your browser.
lanUnavailable: LAN on en0 is unavailable ({code}); local monitoring remains available.
portHelp: Use one port (1–65535) for local HTTP and LAN HTTPS. Changes take effect immediately and are saved for the next start. Reopen the monitor after changing the port.
invalidPort: Enter a whole port number from 1 to 65535.
localPortInUse: Local port {port} is already in use. Choose another port; the current configuration remains active.
lanPortInUse: LAN port {port} is already in use. Choose another port; local monitoring remains available.
portBindFailed: Could not listen on port {port}. Check permissions or choose another port; the current configuration remains active.
portFallback: Configured local port {configured} is unavailable. Temporarily using {actual}; choose and apply an available port.
